what: In the middle of the section a pink ink blot spreads and covers the plate (WebGL). Progress is tied to scroll (smoothstep), so rewinding clears it. Distance takes the farthest corner as 1 and reaches progress×1.35−.05. Only the edge stretches out like fingers with domain-warp noise (strength .82 · scale 3), then at progress .4~1 the roughness is withdrawn so it fills fully with no holes. Color runs from a light center → base → deep edge (at .6 distance of the screen’s long side), with an 8% blotch inside. At progress 0 and 1 it stops and does not draw.

options.--fx-ink-hi · --fx-ink-mid · --fx-ink-lo: Center, background and edge colors, the default is three pinks made from --kf-accent and --kf-accent-text
options.fx:theme: After swapping the Skin, fire at the element to re-read its color

note: Canvas goes at the very front of the element [data-fx-part=ink-canvas] and lay it at z-index −1 — the element’s text sits above the ink. The shader is drawn once on attach to precompile it
use: <section data-fx="ink-blot-scrub" data-fx-ink-blot-scrub="start: top 90%; end: top top">…</section>

from.where: index.js .g-ink (accept section — original warpFill: progress = smoothstep(1.9, 2.6, scroll/screen), roughness .82, panel stuck to the screen)
